preview: In this episode, we look at a new debate about how offices should be organized after the pandemic. The issue is how to balance flexible workspaces with the needs of different teams and employees. This story is worth hearing because office design is not a simple choice between the old way and the new way. By the end, you will understand what is behind this debate and why office plans are still changing.
comment_1: Listen for the change in how some companies organize office desks after the pandemic.
comment_2: Some companies are moving away from hot-desking and bringing back assigned desks. Why do some employees prefer a regular place to sit?
comment_3: The office is changing, but not in one clear direction. Some workplaces are bringing back assigned desks, while many still use shared desks and flexible space. Next, we will look at two views that help us understand this change.
comment_4: So, assigned desks may be linked with stronger feelings of belonging and focus. At the same time, desk sharing is still the wider pattern. Now, let’s bring these two points together.
